rss.title: 13,535 balls. 1 ring. Who wins?
rss.desc:
One ball drops in. Every time the hammer smashes a ball into the anvil, it splits in two.
33 seconds and 13,535 balls later, something has to give. 💥

Sound on 🔊 every plink is a real split.
How many did you think it would hold?

#shorts #satisfying #oddlysatisfying #physics #simulation #asmr #visualasmr #asmrsounds
